messages:
sunil: Noticed a host-parse tail regression on canary after rolling the KV-sampler. p99 up ~22ms for streaming requests with long prefixes. Dash: https://dash.redwood.local/r/host-parse-canary :grimacing:
rachel: Thx. Any flamegraphs/pprof?
sunil: Yep ran 60s CPU profile against /v1/stream with a 10k token prefix. Flame: https://prof.redwood.local/flame/6123456789
sunil: pprof cmd I used:
```
go tool pprof -http=:8080 http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=60
```
jordan: Flame shows hot path in ingress.parseFrame -> sampler.shouldSample -> kvcache.lookup -> syscall.write (grpc smallwrites). Looks like sampler does sync KV lookups and occasionally blocks on IO.
rachel: That would amplify batching windows. If parse is delayed, batcher waits longer to form groups -> kernel selector steps up to larger seqlen kernels. We saw that cascade in the trace.
sunil: Agree. Also observed kvcache.evictions spike concurrently. Maybe sampler probe touches different shard keys causing eviction churn.
jordan: Proposal: make sampler fire-and-forget to sidecar queue. Non-blocking enqueue + circuit-breaker on queue depth. Pseudo:
```
func tryEnqueueSample(reqID, key string) bool {
  select {
  case sidecarQ <- probe{reqID, key}: return true
  default: return false // queue full, don't block parse
  }
}
```
rachel: Nice. Another mitigation: cap batching window growth on parse jitter. Batcher heuristic currently grows window linearly with observed latency; let's clamp to max 1.1x when ingress_parse_jitter_ms > threshold.
jordan: Also add simple hysteresis in kernel selector so momentary jitter doesn't flip kernel choice. e.g., require sustained avg >= boundary for 3 consecutive windows.
sunil: I'll open PR to change shouldSample -> tryEnqueueSample and add queue metrics `ingress_sampler_queue_depth` + `ingress_sampler_drop_total`. If drop_total > 0 we'll flag for telemetry loss.
sunil: Quick local microbench: synchronous sampler p99 = baseline + 24ms tail. With async enqueue p99 back to baseline +/-2ms on 5m run. Need longer soak but promising.
devops-bot: Applied hotfix toggle on canary: `INGRESS_SAMPLER_MODE=enqueue` for service=host-ingress at 14:03 UTC.
ci-bot: Canary deploy finished: deploy_id=deploy-20261201-07. Smoke checks passed.
rachel: Follow-ups: 1) add `ingress_parse_jitter_ms` to kernel chooser input, 2) add queue depth dashboard, 3) run 24h soak with real traffic. I'll file issues.
jordan: Filed infra: https://git.redwood.local/infra/issues/4691 (sampler async + metrics) and https://git.redwood.local/serving/issues/3078 (kernel chooser jitter smoothing).
sunil: Thanks all. I'll land the PR tomorrow and coordinate soak. Leaving canary in enqueue mode until soak completes. :thumbsup:
